name: Crispy Tofu with Lemon Parsley Sauce & Tomato-Arugula Panzanella Salad

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a large baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lemon
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
6 tomatoes
1 (5 oz) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Zest lemon into a medium bowl. Add flour and spices, then stir to combine the coating. (Reserve lemon for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp all-purpose flour
salt
black pepper
½ tsp paprika
oregano, dried

instructions.primary_message: Cut the tofu planks in half crosswise. Add to the bowl with the coating and turn to coat. Set aside. (Reserve baking sheet for the next step.)

Wipe baking sheet dry with paper towels. Cut or tear bread into 2-inch pieces, then transfer to the baking sheet. Drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 slices sourdough bread
extra virgin olive oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until croutons are golden and toasted, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tofu and pan-fry until golden and crispy, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil to keep warm.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place in a small bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the garlic.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl, along with oil, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine the sauce. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place oil, vinegar, and spices in a large bowl, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp red wine vinegar
oregano, dried
salt
black pepper
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice shallot lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Large dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl, along with cooled croutons, arugula, and capers, then toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad and tofu between plates or bowls. Spoon sauce over the tofu and enjoy!
